paragraphs: Chapter 635
Episode 163. Return to the Family (4)
"What... What can you possibly restore to its original state?"
The Sword Garden in Jin's memory, and the Sword Garden spread out in front of him now.
The only common thing between the two was the thousands of swords stuck in the middle of the garden.

The knights visible to the eye were all without exception consumed by chaos, and especially Rosa, was in a state that could not be handled even with the chaos purification device brought from La Frosa.
A single black horn grew on Rosa's forehead. She seemed to have no intention of hiding it, and even if she did, it seemed impossible to hide.
Moreover, the buildings were only the same on the outside.
From the moment Jin first found the Sword Garden.
No, from the moment he entered Calon, he had been feeling the deep chaotic energy hidden throughout the city.
Sigh...
Jin put his hand on his forehead and sighed.
"....Do you mean you can turn back time? Or is there another way with Ilina Runcandel standing next to you, no, the prophet?"

"We can't make what has already happened non-existent. But if you keep your promise, you will immediately become the head of the family here, and in the future, the Lun Kandells will rely on you, not the prophet, for survival."
You will become the head of the family.
The words he had desired since his previous life were piercing Jin's brain.
Of course, he was not happy at all. His head was full of a disgusting sensation like boiling bugs, to the point where he felt nauseous.
"Haha...."
A hollow laughter burst from his mouth without him realizing it.

"Since when were you in a position to select the head of the family? Chiron Runcandel, the head of Runcandel, the owner of Barisada, and my father. All of this, of course, proceeded without his permission. Under your unilateral judgment!"
Of course, Rosa had hinted at making Jin the head of the family even before joining hands with the prophet.
But Jin took it to mean that Rosa would no longer interfere with him becoming the next head, not expecting this kind of succession.
The only one who could directly succeed Barisada was Chiron.
"So, what's your answer? Have you acquired the means to save the family from this turbulent era, or have you not?"
"Whatever I have gained, you and your Runcandel will not benefit from it."
"In that case... I have no other choice."
I have no choice but to kill you.
Rosa's pupils narrowed.
She had no intention of persuading Jin.
Not because she didn't feel it was a waste. Now that she had decided to kill Jin, she was suppressing more pain than ever in her life.
But she couldn't catch him.
The youngest son she knew was never a man of compromise. He never gave in under any circumstances, and he had never broken before....
Rosa knew better than anyone that Jin Runcandel, her youngest son, was that shining man.
"I will ask you one last thing."
Rosa thought Jin would ask about Temar and Hister.
However, even that Jin exceeded Rosa's expectations.
"Was this really the best you could do?"
"Yes."
"Then I guess there's no need for more conversation with you."
Jin's gaze reached the knights standing behind Rosa.
"What were the knights of the family doing to let the Sword Garden reach this state? Was Rosa Runcandel just watching her colluding with chaos?"

"Listening to you talk, it's too much, Jin Runcandel. All you have done so far is damage the fate of Runcandel. And Chiron Runcandel? He was away from the family all the time. What was the result? Have you and he found a way to save the family?"
Jin didn't look at Ilina, who was talking for the first time.

"If it wasn't for Lady Rosa's choice, Runcandel would have been done before the irresponsible Chiron Runcandel and you came back. Well, in a way, it feels like a fulfillment of destiny? After all, Runcandel is much stronger than before...."
Then, a group of knights appeared from far away in the courtyard.
They were the knights who had been trapped underground. They were all exhausted and feeble, but thanks to Stame's care, they were armed with clean armor and swords.
From them, too, a weak chaotic energy was felt.
However, unlike others who were completely consumed, they were full of signs of resistance.
'Those people... are the ones who tried to resist chaos and protect the value of the family.'
It was right to save everyone and go back.
But that was impossible.
They knew it too. Therefore, the Tona brothers shouted for Jin.
"Jin, the youngest...! Don't worry about us and do what you have to do!"
"Having the honor to fight with you and die is an unparalleled honor as a Runcandel...!"
The Tona brothers, who had tormented him so much in his previous life and often showed a cowardly appearance to the strong in this life, had somehow become a proper Runcandel.

"Releasing them now is Lady Rosa's last consideration for you and them. Please decorate the end with the dying men, Jin Runcandel. Anyway, the power you have, even in death, will be used for Runcandel, so it won't be such a bad ending."
"Listen, the knights of the family."
Jin looked at the knights who had come up from underground. They were the only knights of the family.
"I respect your painful resistance. So from now on, what you have to do is to survive. I will open the way for you."
The Tona brothers and the knights nodded heavily.
"From now on, I declare Rosa Runcandel and her followers as rebels, and as the 12th knight of the family... I will execute them."
"I will revoke your knighthood as of this time, Jin Runcandel."
Jin and Rosa spoke simultaneously.
As if it were a promise, all the knights in the circle, except the two of them, drew their swords.
And everyone was thinking of an incident that had occurred in the Sword Garden a few years ago.
-To deepen the meaning of today's declaration, I should eliminate that throne where mother sits.
- [Everyone, open your eyes wide... and see clearly. What is the real Runcandel, what has been protecting Runcandel, and what the current Runcandel is forgetting.]
Family declaration.
A blue fire gathered in Jin's eyes.
Runcandel's Magic Sword Technique
Opportunity - Sarah Runcandel
A blue flame gathered in Jin's eyes.
The will of the Emperor, who had fought for the family until the very end, and who had protected the values of Runcandel for a thousand years even in death, was being embodied through Jin.
Those stained with chaos could only flinch before that blue flame, without knowing.
The energy of chaos was completely paralyzing their inner selves.
Jin had been doing this until he unfolded his karma.
But an immense fear that could not be hidden by the energy of chaos, an overwhelmingly dominant presence, was pounding at the rotten minds of the knights.
"Stop him!"
When Myu and Anne stepped forward, the knights tainted with chaos followed them. Among them were knights wearing black helmets.
Black Knight, a black helmet that was once given only to the most honorable and powerful people in Runcandel.
At a rough estimate, nearly fifty knights in the circle were wearing black helmets.
However, Jin didn't feel any special emotion even though so many black knights were surrounding him.
Not everyone wearing a black helmet is a real black knight, and not everyone who has reached 10 stars becomes a transcendent warrior.
"You guys?"
Hundreds of dark sword energies were pouring down on Jin.
Even a mountain could be brought down in an instant. No one, except for the massive forces, would be able to withstand the sword energy they unleashed in just a few seconds.
Yet their swords couldn't penetrate even the outermost part of the blue flame that Jin had spread. They were being erased without a trace even before they could touch the flame.
What Jin had trained in Lafrarosa was not just the Sword of the King and the Spirit Sword.
Now he was close to mastering the Runcandel's Magic Sword.
Anyone who had seen Sarah Runcandel even once would recognize her standing here.
A fire that burns the world, a fire that never extinguishes in front of any powerful enemy, keeps struggling till the end.
That fire was glaring at the rebels drenched in chaos.
Gaaaaaah...!
The freshly summoned Tess roared.
It was not summoned with the risk of using chaos as a medium, like in the Sword Emperor's Palace. Tess was summoned purely through Jin's magic power, but he had a stronger blue flame than before.
And as soon as Tess appeared, Jin swung his sword towards the rebels once.
Including the five knights who became black knights by the power of chaos, nearly a hundred knights were burned by the flame, and they couldn't even scream as their bodies melted.
Even if their physical bodies melted, like the biogolems, the cores of chaos remained. These cores were returning to the prophet, as if being sucked into a whirlpool.
Jin caught one of the cores of chaos being drawn to the prophet. The chaos tried to parasitize and corrode him by digging into Jin's hand, but as Jin clenched his fist, it burst right there.
For the first time, the prophet seemed to hesitate at this sight.
'Has he become immune to chaos!? Like the old King's tribe...!'
That was something the prophet hadn't expected at all.
Jin, wrapped in the old Runcandel's flame, contrasted with the knights tainted by chaos.
And Jin's flame, as he had said, was paving the way for those who had been released from the underground.
"Ilina Runcandel."
"Yes, Lady Rosa."
"Show your abilities. He must not survive and leave this place today."
Ilina bowed her head at Rosa's command.
"I understand. So, you're allowing me to open the Garden of Swords?"
"I permit it."
The prophet was simply relieved.
If Rosa, having seen Jin's change, broke their contract, she would have to go a long way around.
"Reproduce the nightmare of that day, you rotten ones. If not today, then tomorrow, if not tomorrow, then whenever. Eventually, none of you will survive."
The moment Jin said that.
Suddenly the sun disappeared and the surroundings turned black.
